question: The amount on a sum of ₹6,500 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate of compound interest for 2 years = a + b + (a × b) / 100

⇒ Effective Rate = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10) / 100 = 21%

Total amount after 2 years = 100% (Principal) + 21% (Interest) = 121%

⇒ Amount = 121% of ₹6,500 = (121 / 100) × 6500 = ₹7,865

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,865.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹6,500

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time period (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R / 100)T
